flaws.description: Changed the chart title from 'Income Per Capita Distribution and Economic Development (2006)' to the unrelated and incorrect 'Urban Population Growth Rate Comparison (2006)'.
Swapped the two hex colours in the palette list so Dominican Republic now renders red and Kenya renders blue, contradicting the summary's colour attribution.
Changed one Kenya income data point in the inline list from 1600 to 3600 (multiplied by 2.25), creating a spurious outlier that skews the Kenya KDE curve while the underlying table remains correct.
